name: Amogh
tagline: I study why materials fail, and how to make them better. On the bench and on the fretboard, and now starting to explore that through simulation too.

intro.short: I'm a Metallurgical and Materials Engineering graduate from VNIT Nagpur, currently pursuing an M.Tech in Computational Materials Engineering at IIT Bombay. Most of my work so far has been experimental, things like SEM, mechanical testing and failure analysis, and I'm just starting to explore the computational side of the same questions.
intro.long: I'm a Metallurgical and Materials Engineering graduate from VNIT Nagpur, and I'm currently pursuing an M.Tech in Computational Materials Engineering at IIT Bombay. On the experimental side, I like SEM fractography, mechanical testing and failure analysis. I'm just beginning my journey into the computational side now, starting with things like phase field modeling.
